$comment: Fix broken cross-links in docs/ after reorganization (#47). Criterion: grep finds zero broken docs/ references in guide subfolders.

criteria.target: test $(grep -rn 'docs/[A-Z][A-Z_-]*\.md' docs/how-to/ docs/how-to/ docs/explanation/ docs/how-to/ docs/reference/ docs/reference/ 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r file lineno content; do ref=$(echo "$content" | grep -oP 'docs/[A-Z][A-Z_-]+\.md' | head -1); [ -n "$ref" ] && [ ! -f "$ref" ] && echo BROKEN; done | wc -l) -eq 0
